errors.update: The app is older than the bot. It has to be updated before it can connect.
errors.bad-message: A message wasn't one of the ones above, or a field was missing, the wrong kind or too long.
errors.bad-code: The pairing code is wrong, already used, or older than 10 minutes. Get a new one from /me.
errors.bad-token: The bot no longer knows this app. It was unpaired, so pair it again.
errors.too-many-devices: This person already has the most paired computers allowed. Unpair one in /me first.
errors.too-many-tries: Too many wrong codes or keys from this address. Wait a while.
errors.busy: The bot has as many connections as it takes right now. Try again shortly.
errors.too-fast: The app sent messages or audio faster than the bot accepts.
errors.timeout: The app didn't say who it was in time.
errors.replaced: The same computer connected again, so this older connection was closed.
errors.unavailable: Streaming can't start right now. The message says why.
